summary.text: Jason Kropf is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 54, which includes most of Bend, who has served since January 11, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jason Kropf lives in Bend, Oregon, and his career experience includes working as a public defender and as a deputy district attorney of Deschutes County.
He serves on the board of Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA) of Central Oregon.
He succeeded Cheri Helt in the Oregon House.
